title: Market Lens: competitive velocity dashboard & scenario scripts
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Build a lightweight, operational dashboard (Market Lens) that synthesizes model provider velocity signals, regional availability shifts, and pricing delta scenarios to help enterprise GTM and procurement teams decide reserved capacity vs hosted fallback mixes. Deliverables: 1) a multi-tab dashboard (latency & price delta, availability heatmap, model-release velocity), 2) a set of executable scenario scripts for common buyer journeys (POS, RAG, embeddings-heavy pipelines), and 3) a short runbook that maps dashboard signals to triage actions and procurement triggers. Aim: reduce decision time for procurement/sales by surfacing prioritized signals and recommended actions (3-tier).
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard displays latency, cost-per-token, and availability signals by region and model family for last 180 days
Scenario scripts (3) documented and runnable by Solutions Engineering with sample input workloads
Runbook contains mapping from signal thresholds to recommended actions (notify sales, escalate to infra, price-protect reserve)
Dashboard pulls at least two independent data sources (provider telemetry + internal usage logs) and shows discrepancy alerts
Stakeholder review (GTM, Procurement, Reliability) completed and sign-off recorded

Model-release velocity will be measured as 7-day rolling count of new model variants + change in quantization/compatibility tags.
Scenario scripts will be authored in Python with sample notebooks; Solutions Eng to convert to runbooks if stable.
